//: Config for the Vercel serverless function(s). @vercel/node resolves this by walking up from the entrypoint, so it is used INSTEAD of the frontend tsconfig. It extends the shared base (no `noEmit`, no `allowImportingTsExtensions`) so @vercel/node can emit the function; those Vite-only options in ../tsconfig.json would make emit illegal once @vercel/node forces noEmit:false.
